sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com), English. The host is not reachable from the build machine, so the text was read from the repo's own snapshot of the wiki pages (the .github/wiki folder: the attribute pages and the spell pages, intro and description) and from the search summaries of the live pages. Quoted facts are the wiki's; nothing was invented.
sources.design: Order and thresholds of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs and the strength of the spell: the sources give no chapter or episode for them. See docs/magic/character_spells_rest.md.

spells.name: Butoh Magic (a strike danced)
spells.note: Mode 0 of the Butoh book: spells are cast by dancing.

spells.name: Butoh Magic (trance)
spells.note: The Butoh page: as the user dances, a trance takes them and their attacks become unpredictable.

spells.name: Butoh Dance
spells.note: LEGACY page locked to Kiato since 1.44.0: kept in his set so it stays reachable.

spells.name: Deflect Dash
spells.note: LEGACY page locked to Kiato since 1.44.0: kept in his set so it stays reachable.

spells.name: Union Magic: Sea God Slash
spells.note: Union with Kahono's song: swinging the swords makes shockwaves and flying slashes; a worship of the Sea God.

spells.name: Union Magic: Sea God's Descent
spells.note: Anime only: underwater the dancer swims overhead of the target and is propelled down with tremendous force.

spells.name: Swaying Hand
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): a hand drawn across the air in a slow arc.

spells.name: Heel Stamp
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): the heel comes down and the floor answers.

spells.name: Flowing Water Blade
spells.note: The dancer turns and the water follows (existing page; a dance spell fits the Butoh user).

spells.name: Rhythm Wave
spells.note: Three beats of the heel (existing page).

spells.name: Ebb Step
spells.note: Slipping back like the tide (existing page).

spells.name: Tidal Veil
spells.note: A curtain of water round the sleeves (existing page).

spells.name: Undertow
spells.note: A slow circle on the floor and the sea answers (existing page).

spells.name: Metronome Field
spells.note: A stage with a heartbeat (existing page).

spells.name: Seabed Hymn
spells.note: The worship dance of the Seabed Temple (existing page).

notes: Pages-15 added nine pages to his set so his grimoire shows 15: Flowing Water Blade, Rhythm Wave, Ebb Step, Tidal Veil, Undertow, Metronome Field and Seabed Hymn are this mod's own dance pages (no source names them for Kiato, `design`), and Swaying Hand and Heel Stamp are new. Not in his set (kept in the basic Butoh book): Mirror Step, Serpent Arm, Echo of the Dancer and Crescendo.
